objectives.description: Stage both, regenerate manifest, run both suites + run-all --only, re-run suite_selection_select

approaches_tried.approach: Used `env VAR=val my_shell_function` to pass dynamic fixture env vars into a shell-function call site
approaches_tried.reason: env execs an external binary named by its first argument -- it cannot invoke a shell function at all, so every such call site silently fell through to the wrong URL-dispatch branch or failed outright; fixed by using bash's own prefix-assignment (VAR=val func, or `export "${ARR[@]}"; func` inside the same command-substitution subshell for array-sourced env vars) instead of `env`

approaches_tried.approach: test-sapience-vault-read.sh Case 1 invoked the script under test with no HOME/SAPIENCE_TOKEN override to test the no-token path
approaches_tried.reason: inherited this machine's real ~/.sapience/config.json token and made one real GET call against the live vault, returning real private data instead of exiting 1 as asserted; fixed by isolating HOME to an empty scratch directory and explicitly unsetting SAPIENCE_TOKEN/SAPIENCE_HOST for that case, and adding the same HOME isolation to every other test-suite call-site helper for defense in depth -- recorded as a costly issue-log entry
